info.title: MICROSERVICE-apiwizruntimedoc-Delete Healthcare Appointments Cancel-v5-spec
info.description: The Cancel Healthcare Appointments API allows users to efficiently manage and cancel scheduled healthcare appointments. This endpoint provides a straightforward way for healthcare providers or appointment management systems to process cancellations, ensuring that resources are properly allocated and patient schedules are updated. Ideal for use in healthcare management applications, it facilitates better appointment flow and enhances patient experience. This API is essential for operations involving appointment adjustments, helping to maintain an organized healthcare service.

delete.description: This API endpoint allows you to cancel an existing appointment by sending a DELETE request. Use this to manage your appointments efficiently, ensuring you can remove or reschedule as needed.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to cancel an existing appointment. Please provide the necessary details to identify the appointment that needs to be canceled.

DeleteHealthcareAppointmentsCancelReques.description: The request body for canceling an appointment operation via DELETE method.

DeleteHealthcareAppointmentsCancelRespon.title: Cancel Appointment Response

status.description: Indicates whether the cancellation was successful.

referenceNumber.description: The unique reference number of the canceled appointment.

resultId.description: The ID of the result associated with the cancellation operation.

state.description: The current state of the appointment after the cancellation request.

processingTimeMs.description: The time taken to process the cancellation request, in milliseconds.

message.description: A message providing additional information about the cancellation.

audit.description: Contains details about the audit information for the cancellation process.

DeleteHealthcareAppointmentsCancelRespon.description: This schema represents the response returned when an appointment is successfully canceled.

AuditDetails.title: Audit Details

createdBy.description: The identifier of the user who created the audit entry.

createdAt.description: The date and time when the audit entry was created.

automated.description: Indicates whether the operation was automated.

AuditDetails.description: This schema provides audit details related to the operation performed.

x-processing-time.description: Indicates the processing time, in milliseconds, for the DELETE operation on appointments. A lower value indicates a faster processing time.
